claim_summary: The hub-fire size has an exact finite rational distribution; under lightning c/n its fraction converges to an explicit nondegenerate density, and stationary distinct-leaf covariance converges to a strictly positive age-mixture variance tending to 1/12 as c grows.
integrity: Finite exact rational checks supplement analytic derivations; no independent scientific audit
scientific_limitations: Finite stars with Poisson growth and per-vertex lightning only
Hub-containing fires sampled; singleton leaf events excluded from marked-size law
Endpoint limits are sequential after fixed-c large-star limit
No claimed universality for finite-dimensional lattices; priority remains provisional
title: A critical fire-size and persistent-correlation law for star forest fires
